title: AgRegen: open-source web platform for site-specific nutrient management
description: AgRegen is a Spanish-language web platform for site-specific nutrient management. Three offline reproducible cases cover deterministic NDVI-based nitrogen prescriptions for oat, soil pH and electrical conductivity interpolation, and agronomic calculators. The datasets under data/ are licensed separately under CC BY 4.0.
